headline: Marathon Petroleum beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates
summary: Marathon Petroleum reported third-quarter financial results that surpassed analyst consensus estimates for both earnings and revenue.
why: Downstream refining companies are major drivers of energy sector earnings, influencing cash returns, dividend payouts, and petroleum product supply economics.

impacts.name: Marathon Petroleum
impacts.why: Earnings beat by $1.55 and revenue topped estimates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong earnings and revenue beats driven by robust refining margins increased institutional buying interest in Marathon Petroleum.
